name: Graven Deep
summary: This article is about the group dungeon. For the cemetery, see Deep Graves. Graven Deep is a region located off the southwest coast of High Isle, accessed by ship from Amenos Station. It is connected to a Dwarven observatory located on the seabed, containing a machine capable of manipulating the weather. Dragonflies, frogs, hermit crabs, monkeys and torchbugs are found in numbers within. It is included in the Lost Depths DLC alongside Earthen Root Enclave.
